note: Live-session recording (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Passwords are never in this file: the owner types the connection string once when prepare asks (Server=10.50.0.30,1433;Database=master;UID=<login>;<the login's password entry>;Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes); prepare keeps it in the MG_SQL_BASE variable of this session and derives SQL_CONNECTION_STRING for each database; teardown removes both. T-SQL set-up runs on CON-SQL01 over PowerShell Direct as the lab Administrator with Windows authentication (SQL Server's own sysadmin group is Domain Admins). Episode login: lab_demo, made sysadmin for this episode only (server-state DMVs and ALTER DATABASE for READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT).
prepare: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF SUSER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the login lab_demo first (episode 3 demo.md, setup step 3; owner types its password off camera).', 1;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 0 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin ADD MEMBER lab_demo;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "GRANT VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE TO lab_demo;"
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }

screens.name: t02-top-queries

Open src/sql/t02-top-queries.sql and run it: two rows, scan / 3 / 1 / large AvgLogicalReads and seek / 50 / 2 / single-digit AvgLogicalReads; keep Executions and RankByReads visible

screens.name: t03c-diagnose
steps: Open SSMS 22 and connect to 10.50.0.30,1433 with SQL Server Authentication as lab_demo (secret typed off camera, Remember off); in Options > Connection Properties set the database to ContosoBikesPerf and tick Trust server certificate (lab only) (open three query windows = three sessions: writer, reader, diagnoser)
Diagnoser window: run EXEC Tune.usp_TakeWaitSnapshot N'before-blocking'
Window 1: run src/sql/t03a-blocker.sql (opens a transaction and leaves it open)

Window 3: run src/sql/t03c-diagnose.sql: one row, WaitType LCK_M_S, BlockerOpenTransactions 1, BlockedStatement with the mglab-blocked-report comment, BlockerLastStatement with BEGIN TRANSACTION and the UPDATE

laptop machine name and Windows user name in title bars
session numbers and wait_resource in the diagnosis grid (they change every run)

screens.name: t03-rcsi-reader
steps: Open SSMS 22 and connect to 10.50.0.30,1433 with SQL Server Authentication as lab_demo (secret typed off camera, Remember off); in Options > Connection Properties set the database to ContosoBikesPerf and tick Trust server certificate (lab only) (windows 1 and 2 as writer and reader)
First round: window 1 t03a-blocker.sql, window 2 t03b-reader.sql (blocks), take Tune.usp_TakeWaitSnapshot N'after-blocking', then window 1 t03d-release.sql (ROLLBACK): window 2 returns Shipped
Close windows 1 and 2 and any other connection to the database; from a window on master run src/sql/t03e-enable-rcsi.sql; take the before-rcsi snapshot

Reopen windows 1 and 2 side by side: window 1 t03a-blocker.sql (transaction left open, shown in the status bar), window 2 t03b-reader.sql returns at once with one row Status = Shipped, execution time 00:00:00; point out it is the committed value, not Cancelled

teardown: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF DB_ID(N'ContosoBikesPerf') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER DATABASE ContosoBikesPerf SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE; DROP DATABASE ContosoBikesPerf; END"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.server_principals WHERE name = N'lab_demo') REVOKE VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE FROM lab_demo;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 1 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin DROP MEMBER lab_demo;"
